XDP tile unit test for TX and RX routing, GRE handling, and XSK ring I/O.

# Purpose
This file defines a tile unit test for the `fd_xdp_tile.c` network tile. It builds test packets, sets up a mock network context, and drives both transmit and receive paths through the tile test framework. The code creates packet templates for normal IPv4/UDP traffic and GRE-encapsulated traffic, then checks that the tile selects the correct route, source and destination IP addresses, MAC addresses, and GRE fields for each case. It also checks that packets placed on the XDP TX ring and packets published to the output link match the expected byte content.

The file also sets up the test environment for the `net` tile by creating routing table entries, neighbor table entries, and network device entries in `fd_net_ctx_t`. The [`mock_privileged_init`](<#mock_privileged_init>) function builds a fake XSK and UMEM setup so the test can run without a real kernel XDP socket. The [`main`](<#main>) function initializes the Firedancer topology, installs the mock context, registers the test links, populates test vectors, and runs the test loop twice to verify normal input and output handling.
